class.name: EGPBox3DWorld
class.brief_description: Explicit fixed-tick Box3D simulation with stable entity identifiers and local rollback.
class.description: Owns a Box3D world independent of the scene physics server. Call [method configure], queue commands, then call [method step_tick] once per simulation tick. Commands execute in entity ID and sequence order. Use one constructing thread for every call. Body types are 0 (static), 1 (kinematic), and 2 (dynamic). Every Box3D feature is available through Dictionaries of named fields: bodies with any number of shapes (sphere, capsule, box, convex hull, triangle mesh, height field) with their materials, filters and events ([method queue_create_body], [method queue_set_body], [method queue_add_shape], [method queue_set_shape]); every joint type including EGP's 6DOF joint ([method queue_joint], [method queue_set_joint]); forces, torques and impulses ([method queue_apply]); world settings ([method queue_set_world]) and explosions ([method queue_explode]). Readback ([method get_body], [method get_shape], [method get_joint], [method get_world]), per-step events ([method get_events]) and queries ([method cast_rays], [method cast_shape], [method overlap_aabb], [method overlap_shape], [method move_capsule]) map Box3D shapes back to entity and shape index. [method get_field_names] lists the fields of each set. Snapshots include the solver state and are only for trusted local history on a compatible build. Never restore bytes received from a peer. This class does not replace the physics of [RigidBody3D] or [CharacterBody3D]. Enable [code]physics/box3d/audit_determinism[/code] before configuring a world to run a separate native mirror solver. Commands, fixed steps and trusted restores are repeated and their diagnostic hashes compared. Divergence fails closed with [constant ERR_INVALID_DATA]. Object metadata [code]box3d_audit_verified_steps[/code], [code]box3d_audit_verified_boundaries[/code] and [code]box3d_audit_hash_mismatches[/code] provide evidence. This diagnostic doubles solver work; it is disabled by default and does not implement remote prediction or establish cross-platform determinism.

method.name: apply_queued_commands
method.description: Validates the entire sorted batch before applying mutations without advancing the tick. Use for a baseline or authoritative correction before capturing a snapshot.

method.name: capture_snapshot
method.description: Captures full local solver state and stable body mapping at a boundary with no queued commands. Returns empty bytes on failure. Snapshot size is bounded to 512 MiB.

method.name: cast_rays
method.description: Casts one Box3D ray per origin along its translation and returns the closest hit of each as parallel arrays: [code]hit[/code] ([PackedByteArray], 1 for a hit), [code]fraction[/code], [code]point[/code], [code]normal[/code], [code]entity[/code] and [code]shape[/code] (the hit body's entity and shape index). Shapes overlapping a ray's origin are ignored, so a ray cast from inside a body never hits that body. [param mask] filters by shape category. Queries read the current deterministic state, so every peer with the same state gets the same answers; use them in the deterministic step (ground checks, line of sight).

method.name: cast_shape
method.description: Sweeps a sphere, capsule, box or hull along [param translation] and returns the closest hit: [code]hit[/code], [code]fraction[/code], [code]point[/code], [code]normal[/code], [code]entity[/code], [code]shape[/code]. Equal fractions resolve by identity, so every peer gets the same answer.

method.name: clear_pending_commands
method.description: Clears a rejected or cancelled batch.

method.name: configure
method.description: Configures a new world once. Tick rates range from 1 to 240, substeps from 1 to 16, workers from 1 to 32. Uses meters, float32 and fixed SIMD width. Configuration is immutable.

method.name: configure_fluid
method.description: Defines an axis-aligned fluid volume. Before every [method step_tick], each body enabled with [method set_body_buoyant] whose centre lies inside the volume's horizontal bounds receives a Box3D impulse: Archimedes lift (fluid [param density] x gravity x displaced volume, from the body's mass and shape density, scaled by the submerged fraction of its bounds) and drag proportional to its mass and submersion. Configuration is not part of snapshots: set it up identically on every peer after configuring or restoring the world.

method.name: get_body
method.description: Reads every body field plus [code]world_center_of_mass[/code], [code]shape_count[/code], [code]joint_count[/code] and [code]shapes[/code] (the shape indices). Empty for an unknown body.

method.name: get_body_count
method.description: Returns the live body count.

method.name: get_body_state
method.description: Returns position, rotation, linear_velocity and angular_velocity, or an empty dictionary if the entity is absent.

method.name: get_body_states
method.description: Reads many bodies in one call. Each body produces 13 floats: position xyz, rotation xyzw, linear velocity xyz and angular velocity xyz, in the order of [param entity_ids]. Unknown bodies read as NaN. Prefer this over per-body [method get_body_state] for crowds and per-tick gameplay.

method.name: get_entities
method.description: Every body entity, ascending.

method.name: get_events
method.description: Box3D events of the latest [method step_tick]. Shape pairs are flattened as entity A, shape A, entity B, shape B (entity 0 when a shape no longer exists): [code]contact_begin[/code], [code]contact_end[/code], [code]sensor_begin[/code] and [code]sensor_end[/code] (sensor first, then visitor), and [code]contact_hit[/code] with [code]contact_hit_point[/code], [code]contact_hit_normal[/code] and [code]contact_hit_speed[/code]. [code]moved[/code] lists the bodies that moved, with [code]moved_transforms[/code] (7 floats each: position xyz, rotation xyzw), the efficient way to update visuals; [code]fell_asleep[/code] lists bodies that went to sleep and [code]joint_threshold[/code] joints over their force or torque threshold. Enable contact, sensor and hit events per shape ([code]contact_events[/code], [code]sensor_events[/code], [code]hit_events[/code]).

method.name: get_field_names
method.description: Every field of a set ([code]"world"[/code], [code]"body"[/code], [code]"shape"[/code] or [code]"joint"[/code]) mapped to its [enum Variant.Type].

method.name: get_joint
method.description: Reads the joint's [code]type[/code], [code]body_a[/code], [code]body_b[/code], frames, tuning, every type field and its state: [code]constraint_force[/code], [code]constraint_torque[/code], [code]linear_separation[/code], [code]angular_separation[/code] and, by type, [code]angle[/code], [code]translation[/code], [code]speed[/code], [code]current_length[/code], [code]motor_torque[/code], [code]motor_force[/code], [code]twist_angle[/code], [code]steering_angle[/code] and so on. Generic joint parameters are write-only. Every field is range-checked when queued: Box3D's non-negative stiffness, damping, motor and threshold fields, a target angle within PI, a cone angle in [0, PI], a positive length, and lower/upper limit pairs that stay ordered when merged with the joint's current values. Height fields and compounds need a static body, and a body holding a compound keeps its type.

method.name: get_joint_count
method.description: Returns the number of live joints. Snapshots carry a joint table, so joint identifiers survive [method restore_snapshot]; joints also take part in [method get_state_hash].

method.name: get_joint_ids
method.description: Every joint identifier, ascending.

method.name: get_shape
method.description: Reads the shape's Box3D [code]type[/code] (boxes are hulls), material, density, filter, sensor and event flags, bounds ([code]aabb_lower[/code], [code]aabb_upper[/code]), [code]material_count[/code] and, for meshes and height fields with a table, [code]materials[/code] (entries 1 and up). Empty for an unknown shape.

method.name: get_simulation_fingerprint
method.description: Returns the pinned source revision and simulation profile. Networking must reject incompatible profiles. Matching fingerprints alone do not prove cross-platform qualification.

method.name: get_state_hash
method.description: Returns a 16-character hexadecimal diagnostic hash of the profile, tick, entity IDs, poses, velocities, body types and awake flags. It does not cover every latent solver field and is not cryptographic.

method.name: get_tick
method.description: Returns the last completed 64-bit tick. Restoring a snapshot restores its tick.

method.name: get_world
method.description: Reads world settings and counters ([code]awake_body_count[/code], [code]body_count[/code], [code]shape_count[/code], [code]contact_count[/code], [code]joint_count[/code], [code]island_count[/code], [code]bounds_lower[/code], [code]bounds_upper[/code], [code]tick[/code]).

method.name: move_capsule
method.description: Moves a vertical capsule (centred on [param position]) by [param translation] through the Box3D world with Box3D's character mover: contact planes from [code]b3World_CollideMover[/code], [code]b3SolvePlanes[/code], a sweep with [code]b3World_CastMover[/code], repeated until it settles. The body [param ignore_entity] (usually the character's own capsule) is ignored. Returns [code]position[/code] (where the capsule ends) and [code]clipped[/code] (the translation clipped by the contact planes, for the next velocity). The world is not modified.

method.name: overlap_aabb
method.description: Shapes whose bounds overlap the box, as entity and shape index pairs sorted by identity.

method.name: overlap_shape
method.description: Shapes overlapping a sphere, capsule, box or hull (a shape Dictionary as in [method queue_create_body]) placed at [param position] and [param rotation], as entity and shape index pairs sorted by identity.

method.name: queue_add_shape
method.description: Attaches a shape (same Dictionary as [method queue_create_body]) at an unused [param shape_index] below 256. Shape indices are the stable identities used by events and queries, and they survive snapshots.

method.name: queue_apply
method.description: Applies a force (acting over the next step), torque or impulse. [param point] is the world point for [constant APPLY_FORCE_AT_POINT] and [constant APPLY_IMPULSE_AT_POINT].

method.name: queue_body_state
method.description: Queues a pose and velocities for an authoritative correction. Rotation must already be normalized. Does not reconstruct remote contact caches.

method.name: queue_body_states
method.description: Batched [method queue_body_state]: [param records] holds 13 floats per body in the [method get_body_states] layout. Stops at the first rejected body and returns its error.

method.name: queue_create_body
method.description: Creates a body from any Box3D body fields (see [method get_field_names] with [code]"body"[/code]) and attaches [param shapes] as shape indices 0, 1, 2 and so on. [code]type[/code] accepts [code]"static"[/code], [code]"kinematic"[/code], [code]"dynamic"[/code] or 0-2. Fields Box3D has no definition slot for ([code]mass[/code], [code]center_of_mass[/code], [code]inertia[/code], [code]hit_events[/code], [code]target_position[/code]) are applied right after the shapes. Each shape is a [Dictionary] with a [code]type[/code] ([code]"sphere"[/code], [code]"capsule"[/code], [code]"box"[/code], [code]"hull"[/code], [code]"mesh"[/code], [code]"height_field"[/code], [code]"compound"[/code]), geometry keys and any shape fields ([code]friction[/code], [code]restitution[/code], [code]density[/code], [code]category[/code], [code]mask[/code], [code]sensor[/code], [code]contact_events[/code] and so on). Geometry keys: [code]radius[/code], [code]center[/code] and [code]rotation[/code] (local placement), [code]half_height[/code] or [code]point_a[/code]/[code]point_b[/code] (capsule), [code]half_extents[/code] (box), [code]points[/code] and [code]scale[/code] (hull), [code]points[/code], [code]indices[/code] and [code]scale[/code] (mesh; collides with static bodies only), [code]heights[/code], [code]count_x[/code], [code]count_z[/code], [code]holes[/code] and [code]scale[/code] (height field, placed by its body; static bodies only), [code]children[/code] (baked compound for static bodies: an [Array] of sphere, capsule, box, hull and mesh Dictionaries, each with its own placement and material fields). Meshes and height fields take per-triangle or per-cell materials: [code]materials[/code] (an [Array] of material Dictionaries, table indices 1 and up after the shape's own material 0) and [code]material_indices[/code] (a [PackedByteArray] with one index per triangle or cell). [codeblock] world.queue_create_body(7, 0, {"type": "dynamic", "position": Vector3(0, 4, 0), "bullet": true}, [{"type": "capsule", "radius": 0.4, "half_height": 0.5, "friction": 0.2}, {"type": "sphere", "radius": 0.3, "center": Vector3(0, 1.1, 0), "density": 0.5}]) [/codeblock]

method.name: queue_create_box
method.description: Queues a body with a box hull. Entity ID must be positive. Sequence is a uint32 unique within this entity's current batch.

method.name: queue_create_capsule
method.description: Queues a Y-axis capsule. Half height is the positive half length of its central segment.

method.name: queue_create_joint
method.description: Queues a deterministic Box3D joint between two bodies. [param anchor_a] and [param anchor_b] are body-local; bodies are created unrotated. Joint identifiers form their own namespace. Bodies may be created in the same batch; joints are applied after every body command, in joint identifier order, so all peers build identical constraint graphs. Destroying a body removes its joints. [param options] accepts [code]length[/code] (distance rest length, default 1), [code]hertz[/code] and [code]damping_ratio[/code] (spring stiffness and damping), [code]enable_spring[/code], [code]enable_limit[/code] with [code]lower[/code]/[code]upper[/code] (distance range or prismatic translation), [code]axis[/code] (prismatic slide axis, default +X) and [code]collide_connected[/code]. Unknown keys return [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER]. [codeblock] # Cloth: particle spheres linked by distance joints. world.queue_create_joint(1, 0, EGPBox3DWorld.JOINT_DISTANCE, 10, 11, Vector3.ZERO, Vector3.ZERO, {"length": 0.5}) # Spring slider along X, limited to +/-2 m. world.queue_create_joint(2, 0, EGPBox3DWorld.JOINT_PRISMATIC, 20, 21, Vector3.ZERO, Vector3.ZERO, {"enable_spring": true, "hertz": 1.5, "damping_ratio": 0.1, "enable_limit": true, "lower": -2.0, "upper": 2.0}) [/codeblock]

method.name: queue_create_sphere
method.description: Queues a sphere body.

method.name: queue_destroy_body
method.description: Queues destruction. A subsequent create with a greater sequence may reuse the entity ID.

method.name: queue_destroy_joint
method.description: Queues removal of a joint created by [method queue_create_joint]. Removals apply before body commands and joint creation in the same batch.

method.name: queue_destroy_shape
method.description: Removes one shape and updates the body's mass.

method.name: probe_ground
method.description: Ground support for many characters in one call: casts one ray straight down from each body's position, [param depths] long (for a capsule: half height + radius + a small reach), ignoring the body itself. Returns parallel arrays [code]hit[/code] ([PackedByteArray]), [code]normal[/code] and [code]support[/code] (the supporting entity, 0 when none). Deterministic, read-only.

method.name: queue_drive
method.description: Drives many characters: sets the velocity components selected by [param axes] (bit 0 x, bit 1 y, bit 2 z; the default 5 is horizontal) and keeps the solver's position and the other components, so gravity, jumps and contacts continue naturally. Cheaper and smoother than rewriting full body states every tick.

method.name: queue_explode
method.description: Box3D explosion: pushes shapes within [param radius] (plus [param falloff]) of [param position] whose category matches [param mask], scaled by each shape's [code]explosion_scale[/code]. Runs after the batch's body commands.

method.name: queue_impulse
method.description: Queues a center impulse and wakes the body.

method.name: queue_impulses
method.description: Batched [method queue_impulse]: [param impulses] holds 3 floats per body.

method.name: queue_joint
method.description: Creates any Box3D joint: [code]"distance"[/code], [code]"spherical"[/code], [code]"prismatic"[/code], [code]"motor"[/code], [code]"revolute"[/code], [code]"weld"[/code], [code]"wheel"[/code], [code]"filter"[/code], [code]"parallel"[/code] or [code]"generic"[/code] (EGP 6DOF). Common fields: [code]anchor_a[/code], [code]rotation_a[/code], [code]anchor_b[/code], [code]rotation_b[/code] (body-local frames; prismatic, revolute and wheel joints use the frame's axes), [code]collide_connected[/code], [code]force_threshold[/code], [code]torque_threshold[/code], [code]constraint_hertz[/code], [code]constraint_damping_ratio[/code]. Type fields use Box3D's names in snake case, for example [code]enable_limit[/code], [code]lower_angle[/code], [code]enable_motor[/code], [code]motor_speed[/code], [code]max_motor_torque[/code], [code]suspension_hertz[/code], [code]spin_speed[/code], [code]cone_angle[/code]. Generic joints take one [Vector3] per PhysicsServer3D 6DOF parameter (x, y and z axes): [code]linear_lower_limit[/code], [code]linear_upper_limit[/code], [code]angular_lower_limit[/code], [code]angular_motor_target_velocity[/code], [code]linear_spring_stiffness[/code] and so on, with flags [code]enable_linear_limit[/code], [code]enable_angular_limit[/code], [code]enable_linear_spring[/code], [code]enable_angular_spring[/code], [code]enable_linear_motor[/code] and [code]enable_angular_motor[/code] (a non-zero component enables that axis). Joints are created after the batch's body commands, so bodies and their joints can be created in the same tick.

method.name: queue_linear_velocity
method.description: Queues linear velocity.

method.name: queue_set_body
method.description: Changes body fields through Box3D's runtime setters: type, transform, velocities, damping, gravity scale, motion locks, sleep, bullet, enabled, mass data, hit events, and [code]target_position[/code]/[code]target_rotation[/code] (a kinematic move reaching the target in [code]target_time[/code], one tick by default).

method.name: queue_set_joint
method.description: Changes joint fields through Box3D's runtime setters. Applied after joint creation in the same batch.

method.name: queue_set_shape
method.description: Changes shape fields: surface material ([code]friction[/code], [code]restitution[/code], [code]rolling_resistance[/code], [code]tangent_velocity[/code], [code]user_material[/code]), [code]density[/code] (with [code]update_body_mass[/code]), filter ([code]category[/code], [code]mask[/code], [code]group[/code]) and event flags. With [param material_index] 0 or above, the material fields change that entry of a mesh or height field's material table instead (0 is the shape's own material). Compound materials are fixed at creation.

method.name: queue_set_world
method.description: Changes world settings: [code]gravity[/code], [code]restitution_threshold[/code], [code]restitution_iterations[/code], [code]restitution_propagation[/code], [code]hit_event_threshold[/code], [code]maximum_linear_speed[/code], [code]sleep[/code], [code]continuous[/code], [code]warm_starting[/code], [code]speculative[/code], [code]contact_recycle_distance[/code], and [code]contact_hertz[/code], [code]contact_damping_ratio[/code] and [code]contact_speed[/code]. World commands run after the batch's body commands. Settings are part of snapshots.

method.name: restore_snapshot
method.description: Restores a trusted local snapshot transactionally, retaining the old world if validation fails. Requires no pending commands. The checksum detects accidental damage; it does not authenticate peer data.

method.name: set_body_buoyant
method.description: Lets the fluid volume from [method configure_fluid] act on a body. Like the fluid itself this is configuration: apply it identically on every peer.

method.name: step_tick
method.description: Applies queued commands and advances exactly one fixed step. Expected tick must equal [method get_tick] plus one. The initial step is tick 1. Rejected batches do not mutate the world.

constants.constant: Distance joint: keeps two anchors at a rest length, optionally as a spring or within a length range.
Spherical (ball) joint: the anchors coincide; rotation is free unless a spring is enabled.
Prismatic joint: translation only along [code]axis[/code], optionally sprung and limited.
